```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- paste(
    readLines("_captions/tbl.Calculation.section.reference.md", warn = FALSE),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}
source("scripts/tbl/Calculation.section.reference.R")
PROPERTY.table <- if (Calculation$config$schemaVersion == "3.0.0") {
  Calculation$config$sectionReference$propertyTable
} else {
  Calculation$config$section$propertyTable
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-calculation-section-reference
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP
#| echo: false
buildCalculationSectionReferenceTable(
  pathReference = file.path(
    projectRoot,
    PROPERTY.table
  ),
  pathSection = Calculation$paths$section
)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(CAP, PROPERTY.table, buildCalculationSectionReferenceTable)
```
